en: Vintage advertising postcard featuring an illustration of many patterned socks and stockings fanned out in different colors and designs. At the top is the name of a hosiery factory in bold letters, with additional Danish text below describing capital, bank reference and charitable use of profits. The overall design is vertical with aged, yellowed paper and red and black print.
